findings.reason: A stagewise center/blowup ladder materially clarifies the two distinct scheme-theoretic descent operations: extending the center ideal and flat base change of its blowup. The Galois action can be stated precisely alongside it without conflating semilinearity with smooth-morphism compatibility. The original missing picture is an expository opportunity, not a false theorem.
findings.action: Appended final Remarks with a six-object tikzcd diagram, names and directions of blowup/projection maps, both cartesian relations, and separate Galois-equivariance equations.

correction: Final Remarks addition only; original title, statement, hypotheses, Facts, proof, dependencies, sources and frontmatter retained byte-for-byte.

diagram_math_checks.result: For 0≤i<m, Xi is the descended K-stage, Ci is its smooth closed center, and Xi+1=Bl_Ci Xi. Every barred object is its scheme scalar extension to the fixed algebraic closure Kbar; bar Ci=Ci×K Kbar follows from the extended ideal equality J_Kbar=J(A⊗K Kbar) in proof 2.1. No reduced replacement, geometric-point identification, or new ground-field extension is used. In characteristic zero this algebraic field extension is separable and faithfully flat.

diagram_math_checks.check: Domains, directions and left cartesian square
diagram_math_checks.result: Horizontal hooks are the closed immersions Ci→Xi and bar Ci→bar Xi. Vertical maps have domain the barred scheme and target its K-model, including πi:bar Xi→Xi. The left square commutes and is cartesian because the center ideal extends from J to J_Kbar in proof 2.1; hence bar Ci=bar Xi×Xi Ci as schemes.

diagram_math_checks.check: Right cartesian square and blowup maps
diagram_math_checks.result: bi:Xi+1→Xi and bar bi:bar Xi+1→bar Xi point from the blown-up stage to the preceding ambient stage, not into the center. Proof 3.1 and thm-blowup-base-change-flat identify bar Xi+1 with Xi+1×Xi bar Xi and with Bl_(bar Ci)bar Xi. Thus πi∘bar bi=bi∘πi+1 and the right square is cartesian; the actual supplier proves this by flat pullback of ideal powers/Rees algebra and relative Proj.

diagram_math_checks.check: Semilinear Galois action and center compatibility
diagram_math_checks.result: F2 and proof 1.1 supply induced semilinear automorphisms gσ,i on bar Xi for σ∈AutK(Kbar), preserving the center scheme via its invariant ideal. With these lifted actions, bar bi∘gσ,i+1=gσ,i∘bar bi by naturality of the blowup construction; πi∘gσ,i=πi because σ fixes K. These equations have matching sources and targets. The discussion asserts no Kbar-linearity and no pointwise fixing of the center.

Proof 2.1 reduces coefficients to finite Galois L/K inside Kbar and applies F5/F6, rather than applying finite Galois descent directly to the infinite extension. The figure records only the resulting scheme/ideal identifications. Smooth-morphism compatibility remains the separate comparison of proof 3.1; no stronger canonicity or additional functoriality is introduced. The complete original proof remains independent of the figure.
